prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 cultural-event poster for Korean neighborhood adults, displayed on subway and community digital screens. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Whole design: An intimate outdoor film screening becomes a conversation among audience members beneath a bridge. Strong close foreground human crops form physical parentheses around a broad plain warm-off-white central information corridor. Concentrated deep burgundy occupies the image territories on both sides; the human shapes are warm off-white and dense black, with crisp controlled high-contrast editorial image cuts. Natural adult proportions, credible faces and hands; welcoming, thoughtful, grown-up mood.

Composition: The outer roughly 26% on each side contains a large adult shoulder and inward-facing profile, both cropped by their respective outer edges and bleeding through the bottom. They belong to one shared outdoor scene, with convincing foreground scale. Keep the central x28–71% corridor uniformly warm off-white, open and calm from top through bottom; all type stays wholly inside it with useful margin from silhouette edges. The right adult is about to speak, receiving a recognizable handheld microphone from a neighboring audience member's naturally cropped hand entering from the lower-right; show a convincing exchange with anatomically legible fingers and wrist-to-hand contact, entirely in the right image territory. This handoff and the close listener profiles carry the first gaze. Entirely in the upper-left image territory, beyond the left foreground listener, show a smaller distant luminous rectangular projection screen with a silent film image, beneath an unmistakable overhead bridge beam, with a few small seated audience shapes. Clear scale difference links near conversation and distant cinema. Neither screen nor gesture enters the central corridor. No disconnected decorative portraits or celebrity likeness.

Type: Clean ordinary Korean sans-serif with intact Hangul counters, consistent proportions and clear word spaces, dark near-black on plain off-white. Left-align every copy group to one central left edge. At a 720px-wide viewing size, the single-line Korean title is approximately 34px, English 18px, activity 18px on two lines at a word boundary; date 21px, time 28px, venue 18px, each practical line at least 17px and slightly heavier. The title must remain on one line fitting the approximately 310px corridor. Stack identity and activity in y5–39%, date/time/place in y43–65%, then all four practical entries in y71–96%. Use intentional spacing and strong text hierarchy; every practical entry must be clearly readable at width720. The information corridor stays flat and clean; faces, hands, clothing and bridge are carefully controlled tonal cuts with finished edges.

Print ONLY the following ten entries, each exactly once, preserving all spelling, capitalization, word spaces, numerals and punctuation. No fixed line breaks; only the long activity entry should wrap to two lines at a word boundary. The following order maps to identity, schedule/place, then attendance guidance:
다리 아래 영화관
BRIDGE CINEMA
야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화
2026.12.05 토요일
18:00–20:30
홍제천 연가교 아래
17:30부터 입장
돗자리 지참
무료 관람 · 선착순 80명
우천 시 실내로 변경

Constraints: One independent complete poster filling the whole landscape16:9 canvas, no contact sheet, multiple poster panel, photograph of a poster, frame, perspective mockup, transparency, stretching or portrait crop. Substantive people, microphone exchange and outdoor film-screen scene are essential; do not substitute a type-only composition, small icons or texture. No extra printed text of any size, labels, headings, logos, watermark, QR, pseudo-writing, invented event details or decorative symbols. Render all ten entries once as legible finished typography. This design is the close foreground conversation composition with a central light corridor.
